# pve_pool (Resource)

Resource pool (grouping of guests and storages; members are computed).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_pool" "example" {
  poolid = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `poolid` (String) <string>

### Optional

- `allow_move` (Boolean) Allow adding a guest even if already in another pool. The guest will be removed from its current pool and added to this one. (default: 0)
- `comment` (String) <string>
- `delete` (Boolean) Remove the passed VMIDs and/or storage IDs instead of adding them. (default: 0)
- `storage` (String) List of storage IDs to add or remove from this pool.
- `vms` (String) List of guest VMIDs to add or remove from this pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: poolid (also the `terraform import` format).
- `members` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)
